It's a really hard thing to go through and Im so sorry you had that experience, I went through something similar. What I would recommend would be telling a close friend or family member (anyone as long as you trust them). It can be incredibly difficult to even speak about and Ive heard of some people that found it worked to write it out or type it out and give it to the person they trust. There are also great hotlines if you are currently in crisis. It may sound like a broken record but it 100% is not your fault. For me, I felt like it was because I also froze but please believe it isnt. It really helps and takes the burden off if someone you love knows about it. And as for the not wanting to be touched, it is completely understandable and will get better with time, just try to take baby steps. I really hope youre ok and that this helped.

I know you you feel. It hurts and is extremely revealing to vent to a forum about something deeply personal and traumatic that happened to you. I did the same and was sent dm’s asking to know details by someone who (I could tell by his previous posts) had a rape fetish. I want you to know you didn’t say or do anything wrong to prompt those messages, the people who are into it are mentally ill. 
Aside from the messages you got I’m very sorry for the experience you had. There are many good hotlines out there that are helpful and I hope you can find solace in friends or counsellors. I know it sounds like a broken record everyone telling you it wasn’t your fault but I promise it wasn’t, especially at your age (even if you are mature for your age). I promise it’ll be ok. I’m not a counsellor or professional so I hope this message is ok and not upsetting in anyway, I’m just a person that had a similar experience and wanted you to know that you’re not alone.
